scenario: source drift, expiry, semantic conflict, and reference integrity detection
proves: evidence entries with source_content_hash can detect source drift
entries with references can detect missing referenced memory ids
project/evidence entries with retrieval_count 0 can be marked as never retrieved
entries with expires_at can be marked expired
same-scope project memories with conflicting semantic_tags can be flagged
reference cycles can be detected during cleanup
limits: semantic contradiction detection is tag-based, not deep natural-language entailment
TTL policy is field-driven and does not yet assign expiry automatically by layer
circular references are detected during clean, not prevented before write
